checks.name: Media Session registers eight system actions
Default title and artist use the song, not document title
Default artwork is its song background, not the app icon
Media Session initialization does not autoplay
System play starts native audio and updates UI
System pause synchronizes native audio, UI and platform state
Absolute system seek stays paused
System seek backward defaults to ten seconds
System seek forward honors supplied offset
Position state includes valid native duration/rate/position
Playback-rate changes reach the platform
Invalid system seek is ignored safely
System next changes metadata/artwork and preserves playback
System previous uses existing playlist navigation
Paused system next does not autoplay or load the audio element
Lazy system seeks reuse metadata queue and keep the final request
Instrumental mode appears in platform album metadata
Changing mode preserves the song background and position
System playlist controls retain instrumental mode
System stop pauses and resets without selecting another song
